initialization: fresh LM LoRA on frozen SAMTok base; do not initialize from pilot or smoke
lr_schedule: 3% global-update linear warmup; continuous cosine to 10% peak, without reset at data-stage boundary
curriculum: one pass over accepted warmup, then one pass over accepted main; no repeated full epochs
pair_policy: counterfactual partners in the same global optimizer update
last_batch: keep all real requests; zero-loss padding and normalize by real request count
dev_evaluation: after data warmup, every 500 main updates, and final update
checkpoint_selection: dev unknown.strict_iou; exact ties choose earlier update
test_policy: evaluate only after the dev-selected checkpoint has been recorded
frozen_checks: base parameter SHA256 and exact adapter-off logits / pre-norm TE probe for every training segment
dataloader_note: Load in each GPU training process; NAS TMPDIR exceeds AF_UNIX socket path length for multiprocessing DataLoader
resume_guarantee: FP32 adapter, optimizer, sample position and per-rank RNG restored; GPU training is numerically nondeterministic, not bitwise replay
